entries.baseline: Two real unused reads; two committed users and participants; exactly one consumed invite and login row. Loser is 400 polis_err_treevite_invite_race_condition and retains membership without a login credential.
entries.target: Atomic admission rolls back the loser and returns invalid-or-used. The baseline records a defect, not a compatibility requirement.

entries.baseline: Acceptance retains the existing positive-PID XID/account UID and issues an anonymous login credential. Removing the XID from the allow-list refuses the original XID but not the converted anonymous credential.
entries.target: Refuse identity conversion on accept; accept/login create or resume anonymous identities only. Recovery is a separate decision.

entries.baseline: PID zero forks a new user; a positive-PID anonymous token from another conversation reuses its UID.
entries.target: Reuse same-conversation PID zero and keep anonymous identity local to its conversation.

surge_ruling: TQ2: surge is never throttled. This small functional corpus does not measure capacity or add throttling. Conversation and owner ceilings are sanity stops; wave repeat controls and capacity reservation are separate work.
observed_policy: Treevite disabled is not a refusal on these routes. An allow-listed bare XID plus invite admits a fresh anonymous participant; a verified existing XID bearer follows the TQ1 conversion case.
